objects.name: Admin
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "Admin" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "email" TEXT NOT NULL, "passwordHash" TEXT NOT NULL, "createdAt" DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "updatedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL)

objects.name: Product
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "Product" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "rowNumber" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "listPrice" INTEGER, "finalPrice" INTEGER, "discountAvailability" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "lastDiscountPercent" REAL, "createdAt" DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "updatedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL)

objects.name: User
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "User" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "username" TEXT NOT NULL, "passwordHash" TEXT NOT NULL, "createdAt" DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "updatedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL)

ledgerObjects.name: _sabalan_inquiry_migrations
ledgerObjects.sql:
CREATE TABLE "_sabalan_inquiry_migrations" (
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "sqlSha256" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "schemaSha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "appliedAt" TEXT NOT NULL) WITHOUT ROWID

ledgerObjects.name: sabalan_inquiry_history_no_update
ledgerObjects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER "sabalan_inquiry_history_no_update" BEFORE UPDATE ON "_sabalan_inquiry_migrations"
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'INQUIRY_MIGRATION_HISTORY_IMMUTABLE'); END;

ledgerObjects.name: sabalan_inquiry_history_no_delete
ledgerObjects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER "sabalan_inquiry_history_no_delete" BEFORE DELETE ON "_sabalan_inquiry_migrations"
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'INQUIRY_MIGRATION_HISTORY_IMMUTABLE'); END;
